component.name: Knife Edge Recompiled
component.summary: Static-recompilation PC port of Knife Edge - Nose Gunner (N64)

description.p: Knife Edge Recompiled is a static-recompilation PC port of Knife Edge - Nose Gunner, a 1998 Nintendo 64 rail-shooter by Kemco. The game's original MIPS machine code is translated ahead of time into native code (no emulation) using N64Recomp, with rendering handled by RT64.

This project contains no Kemco assets, game data, or ROM content -- only independently reverse-engineered control-flow structure needed to recompile the game's own machine code. It REQUIRES you to already own a legally obtained Knife Edge - Nose Gunner (USA) ROM: no game data is included, and none can be downloaded through this app. On first run, you will be asked to pick your ROM file through a file-open dialog.

Optional enhancements over the original 1998 release (higher-resolution 3D rendering, widescreen, and an uncropped in-mission view) are available and off by default; vanilla behavior is preserved exactly unless you opt in.
